articles.title: Wall Street rethinks AI data center boom as Texas election raises new risks
articles.snippet: Bitcoin miners pivoting to AI face new uncertainty over power access and construction permits, while companies with approved projects could benefit from tighter supply.

articles.title: Zcash grants committee drops plan to redirect 98,000 ZEC to future mining rewards
articles.snippet: The committee withdrew its proposal after community backlash, leaving competing plans to cut off its funding or preserve the existing grants system.

articles.title: U.S.-sanctioned Moscow Exchange to list bitcoin and Tether’s USDT in December
articles.snippet: Russia’s main bourse wants back the crypto trading Russians do abroad, and one of the coins it's listing is issued by a company that freezes wallets on the U.S. sanctions list.

articles.title: How Aussie Bitcoiners can avoid 2027’s shock CGT hike: Part 1
articles.snippet: From setting up an SMSF or a company, to just leaving the country entirely, here are some strategies Australian Bitcoiners can employ to deal with 2027’s massive CGT hike.

articles.title: Circle’s ARC token sale lifts earnings as lower yields weigh on USDC income
articles.snippet: Circle is looking to payments fees and future staking rewards to diversify revenue as its core stablecoin business faces pressure from lower yields and growing competition.
